nodes.label: FALCON Signature Scheme
nodes.description: Lattice-based digital signature scheme using NTT/Fast Fourier Transform over polynomial rings. Variants: 512, 1024, padded_512, padded_1024. Implementations: ref (clean C), avx2 (SSE), aarch64 (NEON/NTT).

nodes.label: MAYO Signature Scheme
nodes.description: Multivariate quadratic signature scheme. Variants: MAYO_1 through MAYO_5. Implementations: opt, avx2, neon. Uses arithmetic, params, api modules.

nodes.label: ML-DSA Signature Scheme
nodes.description: NIST-standardized module-lattice-based digital signature (FIPS 204 / Dilithium). Variants: 44 (level 2), 65 (level 3), 87 (level 5). Implementations: ref (clean C), avx2 (SSE assembly). Core modules: ntt, packing, poly, polyvec, reduce, rounding, sign, symmetric-shake.

nodes.label: SPHINCS+ Signature Scheme
nodes.description: Stateless hash-based signature scheme. Hash variants: sha2, shake. Security levels: 128, 192, 256. Parameter sets: f (fast), s (small). Implementations: clean (ref C), avx2 (SSE). Core modules: address, fors, hash, merkle, sign, thash, utils, wots.

nodes.label: UOV Signature Scheme
nodes.description: Unbalanced Oil and Vinegar multivariate signature scheme. Parameter variants: Is (16/160/64), Ip (256/112/44), III (256/184/72), V (256/244/96). Modes: pkc (public key crypto), skc (secret key crypto). Implementations: ref, neon, avx2. Core modules: blas_matrix, ov, ov_keypair, ov_publicmap, sign, utils_hash, utils_prng.

nodes.label: LMS Stateful Signature
nodes.description: Leighton-Micali hash-based stateful signature scheme. Cisco Systems implementation (MIT licensed). Core modules: hss (hash-based signature scheme), lm (Leighton-Micali OTS), endian, hash. Single-threaded signing.

nodes.label: XMSS Stateful Signature
nodes.description: Extended Hash-Based Signature scheme. Hash functions: sha256, shake128, sha512, shake256. Tree heights: h10, h16, h20. Security variants: _192, _256. XMSSMT (multi-tree) variants: h20_2, h40_2, h40_4, h40_8, h60_3, h60_6, h60_12. Core modules: core_hash, hash_address, params, utils, wots, xmss_commons, xmss_core_fast.

nodes.label: XMSSMT Multi-Tree Signatures
nodes.description: Multi-tree variant of XMSS with parallel tree signing. SHA256 and SHAKE128 hash families. Tree height/arity combinations: h20_2/4, h40_2/4/8, h60_3/6/12.

nodes.label: PQClean Shims
nodes.description: Common include directory providing shim headers used by all PQClean-based signature implementations (FALCON, MAYO, ML-DSA, SPHINCS+, UOV). Standardizes API across PQClean implementations.

nodes.label: liboqs Test Suite
nodes.description: Comprehensive test infrastructure: KEM tests (example, kat, test, test_mem, speed, vectors), SIG tests (example, fuzz, kat, test, test_mem, speed, vectors), SIG_STFL tests (kat, test, speed). Optional Valgrind-based constant-time detection. Python pytest harness with parallel execution.

nodes.label: Constant-Time Test Detection
nodes.description: Valgrind-based detection of non-constant-time behavior in cryptographic operations. Enabled via OQS_ENABLE_TEST_CONSTANT_TIME option. Incompatible with non-debug builds.

nodes.label: Fuzz Testing
nodes.description: LLVM libFuzzer-based fuzzing for signature APIs. Enabled with OQS_BUILD_FUZZ_TESTS and Clang compiler. Target: fuzz_test_sig.

nodes.label: Known Answer Tests
nodes.description: KAT (Known Answer Tests) for KEM, SIG, and SIG_STFL algorithms. Validates implementations against NIST-standard test vectors. Includes intermediate value vector tests.

nodes.label: Zephyr RTOS Port
nodes.description: liboqs integration as Zephyr RTOS module. Kconfig-based algorithm selection. Supports 32-bit ARM, 64-bit ARM, x86, x86_64, Native Posix architectures. Requires custom RNG callback via OQS_randombytes_custom_algorithm(). Embedded build: OQS_BUILD_ONLY_LIB, OQS_EMBEDDED_BUILD.

nodes.label: Zephyr Kconfig Integration
nodes.description: Configurable KEM and SIG algorithm enablement via CONFIG_LIBOQS_ENABLE_* options. NIST-standardized algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA) enabled by default. Other algorithms disabled by default. CROSS variants with large stack usage disabled.

nodes.label: Zephyr Sample Applications
nodes.description: Two sample apps: KEMs (liboqs_kems) and Signatures (liboqs_signatures). Integration platforms: qemu_x86, qemu_cortex_a53, qemu_riscv32, qemu_riscv64. Console harness with 'Test done' verification.

nodes.label: foretias-p2p Python Bindings
nodes.description: Python bindings for Foretias P2P attestation engine via PyO3. Provides PyCryptoServer and related classes for signing/verification from Python. Built with maturin.

nodes.label: CPU Architecture Optimizations
nodes.description: Common optimization variants across all signature schemes: ref (portable C), avx2 (x86 SIMD with -mavx2, -mpopcnt), neon (ARM SIMD), aarch64 (ARM64-specific with NTT). AVX2 variants often include multiplication table optimizations (-D_MUL_WITH_MULTAB_).

nodes.label: Signature Scheme Categories
nodes.description: liboqs organizes signatures into two categories: stateless (SIG) and stateful (SIG_STFL). Stateless: FALCON, MAYO, ML-DSA, SPHINCS+, UOV. Stateful: LMS, XMSS, XMSSMT. Stateless schemes do not require signer state tracking; stateful schemes require counter management.

nodes.label: LMS Cisco License
nodes.description: LMS implementation derived from Cisco Systems code (2017), MIT license. Separate licensing from rest of liboqs which uses MIT/Apache-2.0/CC0-1.0 combinations.

nodes.label: CMake Object Library Pattern
nodes.description: All signature implementations use CMake OBJECT libraries with conditional compilation flags. Object libraries are aggregated into category-level variables (FALCON_OBJS, MAYO_OBJS, etc.) via PARENT_SCOPE. Enables selective inclusion of algorithm variants.

nodes.label: ML-DSA Dilithium Mode Mapping
nodes.description: ML-DSA parameter mapping: ml_dsa_44 uses DILITHIUM_MODE=2, ml_dsa_65 uses DILITHIUM_MODE=3, ml_dsa_87 uses DILITHIUM_MODE=5. Corresponds to NIST security levels 2, 3, 5.

nodes.label: UOV Parameter Convention
nodes.description: UOV variants encode parameters in name: ov_Is (n=16, m=160, o=64), ov_Ip (n=256, m=112, o=44), ov_III (n=256, m=184, o=72), ov_V (n=256, m=244, o=96). Mode suffixes: pkc (public-key), skc (secret-key). Pre-quantum security levels: I (lowest) through V (highest).

nodes.label: XMSS Hash Parameter Mapping
nodes.description: XMSS compile-time hash selection: HASH=1 (sha256 128-bit), HASH=2 (shake256 192-bit), HASH=3 (sha256 256-bit), HASH=4 (shake128 256-bit), HASH=5 (shake256 256-bit), HASH=6 (sha512), HASH=7 (shake256 256-bit). Combined with XMSS_PARAMS_NAMESPACE for each variant.
